title: Cancellation Fee on Northgate Protect Standard Plans Measured against the Manufacturer Warranty
content:
On a Northgate Protect Standard 2-Year or Standard 3-Year plan canceled at the plan holder's request, the Standard plan's cancellation fee depends on the whole months from the coverage start date to today against the covered order line's manufacturer warranty months, as the customer's Northgate Store and Online Orders records show them:

| Whole months from coverage start date to today | Cancellation fee |
|---|---|
| Fewer than the warranty months | No fee |
| At least the warranty months but fewer than the warranty months plus the warranty tail of 6 months | The lesser of the tail fee rate of 5 percent (0.05) times the price kept and the tail fee cap of $15.00 |
| The warranty months plus 6 months or more | Not set by this clause |

The price kept is the plan's one-time charges less any refunds already booked on it.

## Cases on hypothetical figures

| Warranty months on the line | Whole months covered | Price kept | Fee under this clause |
|---|---|---|---|
| 12 | 11 | Any | No fee |
| 12 | 12 | $82.00 | The lesser of $4.10 and $15.00: $4.10 |
| 12 | 17 | $400.00 | The lesser of $20.00 and $15.00: $15.00 |
| 12 | 18 | Any | Not set by this clause |
| 0 | 0 to 5 | $82.00 | $4.10 (no month count is fewer than 0) |
| 0 | 6 or more | Any | Not set by this clause |
